regions.region: upper-left Experimental Section and Synthesis of the Starting Materials
regions.finding: The anhydrous-MeCN sentence is a general solvent-preparation note. Three distinct starting-material syntheses (1i, 1j, 1r) were extracted; 1i is fully procedural while 1j and 1r are abbreviated experiments with explicit missing details retained.

regions.region: upper-right through lower-right iodohydroxylation procedures for E-3a and E-3b
regions.finding: Detailed quantities, staged addition, workup, purification and component yields were merged into the existing Eq. (1) and Table 2 entry 2 records rather than duplicated.

regions.region: bottom-right abbreviated E-3c preparation
regions.finding: Exact charges and isolated E/Z/E-4c outcomes were merged into Table 2 entry 3; operations inherit the explicitly referenced E-3b procedure.

unresolved: The 1j and 1r paragraphs omit some or all duration, atmosphere, solvent/temperature, and workup details; these were not inferred from the 1i procedure.
The exact identity of the reagent printed only as 'sulfenyl chloride' was not expanded beyond the source label.

regions.region: upper-left continuation of E/Z-3c characterization and E-3d preparation
regions.finding: Characterization continuation was inspected; the E-3d batch charges and E/Z/E-4d isolated outcomes were merged into Table 2 entry 4.

regions.region: left column E-3e and E-3f preparations
regions.finding: Exact masses and isolated main/side-product outcomes were merged into Table 2 entries 5 and 6, retaining the page-7 typical procedure as operational evidence.

regions.region: right column E-3g through E-3i preparations

regions.region: bottom-right E-3j preparation beginning and cross-page continuation
regions.finding: Charges and E/Z/E-4j outcomes were merged into Table 2 entry 10; characterization continues on page 9.

unresolved: The abbreviated scope paragraphs rely on the page-7 E-3b procedure and do not independently restate every addition, workup, or purification operation.
Spectral characterization was inspected for experiment identity but not modeled as reaction conditions or outcomes.

regions.region: top-left E/Z-3j characterization and E-3k preparation
regions.finding: The E-3j cross-page continuation was reconciled; E-3k exact charges and E-4k outcome were merged into Table 2 entry 11.

regions.region: middle-left detailed E-3l procedure
regions.finding: The detailed 1 min iodine addition plus 45 min stirring, workup, purification, masses and isolated yields were merged into Table 3 entry 5; the 46 min table duration is retained as the total.

regions.region: lower-left and right-column E-3m through E-3q preparations
regions.finding: Five Table 4 scope rows were enriched with exact masses and E-4 byproduct isolated yields, using the explicitly referenced E-3l procedure for shared operations.

regions.region: bottom-right beginning of E-3r preparation

regions.finding: Table 4 entries 6-8 were enriched with isolated masses and E-4 byproduct yields; E-3r was treated as one cross-page experiment, not two records.

regions.region: middle-left chiral (R)-E-3g preparation

regions.region: upper-right through middle-right E-4f, E-4g and (R)-E-4g oxidations
regions.finding: The E-4f and chiral E-4g procedures were merged into their existing Scheme 4/Eq. (4) records. The racemic E-3g to E-4g oxidation is a distinct batch and was added as one new record.

regions.region: lower-right Sonogashira product 6 procedure beginning
regions.finding: Detailed charges, nitrogen atmosphere, reaction and workup were merged into the existing Scheme 4 record; isolated mass/yield continues on page 11.

unresolved: The source prints CuI as 7.6 mg and 0.4 mmol in the Sonogashira batch; the internal inconsistency is preserved without correction.
The abbreviated E-4g paragraphs inherit the preceding oxidation workup and do not restate every operation.

regions.region: top-left completion and characterization of Sonogashira product 6
regions.finding: The 57.2 mg, 90% isolated outcome was merged with the page-10 Sonogashira batch; characterization was inspected but not turned into reaction conditions.

regions.region: middle-left Suzuki product 7 procedure
regions.finding: Exact charges, 30 °C/nitrogen conditions, workup, purification and isolated mass were merged into the existing Scheme 4 record. The page-6 scheme's room-temperature label was retained as a source discrepancy.

regions.region: lower-left typical E-3a to Z-3a isomerization procedure
regions.finding: This batch matches Table 5 entry 3 (1.5 equiv I2, 15 h, 91%, E/Z 5/95); exact scale, workup and Z-3a isolated mass were merged rather than duplicated.

regions.region: bottom-left acknowledgements and full right-column references/crystal-data note
regions.finding: No additional batch experiment was present. The crystal-data paragraph characterizes E-4g and the reference list cites prior work; neither was counted as a new reaction.

unresolved: Scheme 4 reports room temperature for product 7 while the detailed procedure reports 30 °C; both statements remain in the record.
